NEUTRALITY DOCTRINE: 'You cannot take sides in the divorce, even though it's very easy to do so' - equal simultaneous communication to both parties + counsel, everything documented, decisions pre-wired IN WRITING (price changes, showing terms, deadlines) so nothing becomes a new fight. espinosa.name: Nicole Espinosa
espinosa.style: Complete package on first submission, drive the bank, know the sale-date clock. The riches are in the niches.
espinosa.deep: RESEARCHED (We Close Notes EP454 long-form; Real Estate Rockstars/REDX; her books Short Sales Uncensored / Mastering Short Sales). First question ALWAYS: 'Are you in foreclosure - do you have a sale date?' The timeline decides the options. Pre-qualify: a viable loan modification DISQUALIFIES the short sale. COMPLETE-PACKAGE DOCTRINE - negotiators pick her files first because everything is there on submission one: SHORT hardship letter ('they want short and sweet', date the hardship), 2 months bank statements, 2 pay stubs, 2 years taxes, servicer-specific forms, authorization letters. Frame for the owner: 'You're not applying for a new loan, but you are asking for assistance.' DRIVE THE BANK: 'The banks will not call you. This is not a thing.' ted.name: Ted Thomas
ted.style: Invest directly with the government. 'I won't buy anything unless I look at it.' Know the rules, do the homework.
ted.deep: RESEARCHED (REtipster ep196 long-form; tedthomas.com first-tax-deed guide; AdvantaIRA ep121). 30+ years as the tax lien/deed authority. LIENS: 'a tax lien is nothing more than a piece of paper' - buy the delinquent tax debt from the county, get paid principal + statutory interest at redemption (~97% pay off; unredeemed -> foreclose, usually mortgage-free). State rates he cites: AZ 16%, FL 18%, IL 18%, IA 24%, TX up to 25%; range 8-50% - every county's code differs. DEEDS: county auctions the title - 'mortgage-free real estate for 10, 20 or 30 cents on the dollar' (CA = deed state, 5+ yrs delinquent). THE 20-30-3-1 FUNNEL: research 20-30 properties, bid ~3, win 1-2; max bid from exit math BEFORE arriving; walk away freely. loida.name: Loida Velasquez
loida.style: 30 real conversations a day. Ask 'what happened?' before you pitch. Frustration = motivation signal.
loida.deep: RESEARCHED (PropStream Pros profile; REDX live-scripts feature; Realtyna interview; loidavelasquez.com). Real Broker agent, CA+FL, built from scratch (first listing Nov 2015) purely on cold calls, doors, expireds & FSBOs; 95K+ YouTube subs / 5M views of no-fluff prospecting training; bilingual EN/ES - serves Spanish-speaking clients and trains Spanish-first agents; hosts New In Real Estate Podcast. DOCTRINE: expireds/FSBOs are 'the lowest hanging fruit' - owners already raised their hand; most agents avoid them out of rejection fear. THE 30-CONVERSATION STANDARD: 30 real conversations daily, held through rejection streaks - a signature deal came on call #30 after a day of nos. DISCOVERY BEFORE PITCH: open with 'What happened?' / 'Why were you trying to sell?'; key read: 'The more frustrated someone is over the phone, it's probably because they were very motivated to sell.' CEO of The Fig Team (eXp+PLACE, Orlando, 20 yrs): #1 eXp MEGA TEAM by units 2021 AND 2022, peak 2,200 homes/yr, $646M volume in a single year, 36 agents + 14 staff; top-5 Hispanic agents nationally (NAHREP); Zillow Advisory Board since 2016; Inman Most Innovative Team 2017 (early iBuyer partnership); Orlando City Soccer's official real estate partner. Bilingual edge evolved from translator to competitive weapon: master the FINANCING programs others never learn (foreign-national loans, ITIN paths, DPA) and serve multiple client types. creyes.name: Carlos Reyes
creyes.style: 'We're marketers that do real estate investing.' Numbers religion. The immigrant mindset as fuel.

Undocumented immigrant from Sonora, Mexico (single mom, two jobs at $7-8.25/hr) -> with partner Sal Shakir built National Cash Offer/OfferKey: $200M+ wholesaled, 8-figure annual earnings, 12-15 simultaneous markets, 31+ businesses; All In Nation education brand. DATA-DRIVEN MARKET SELECTION for virtual wholesaling: score cash-transaction volume, avg DOM, median price, demographics BEFORE spending (he hired a data scientist); first virtual market Las Vegas - first deal $5K from bandit signs + mail. rene.name: Rene Rodriguez
rene.style: Frame, message, tie-down - in that order. Your obstacles are your credibility. Tell the story in their heart language.
rene.deep: RESEARCHED (Summaries.com book breakdown; Real Business Connections ep28; meetrene.com/amplifiimylife.com; HousingWire keynote coverage). WSJ-bestselling author 'Amplify Your Influence' (Best Business Book 2022); 27 years applying behavioral neuroscience to sales/leadership; AMPLIFII taught to 100,000+ (mortgage/real estate = core audience); HousingWire Annual keynoter. THE AMPLIFII FRAMEWORK - 'It's the SEQUENCE that counts': (1) FRAME - 'always frame your conversation so people are prepared'; whoever sets the frame controls how the message lands (price frame vs value frame vs risk frame); (2) MESSAGE - clear and concise; (3) TIE-DOWN - a locking question that prompts agreement. ORIGIN/IDENTITY STORY: a frame answering exactly two questions - HOW you arrived where you are and WHY you love serving who you serve; ~90 seconds, delivered at every listing appointment BEFORE the CMA. buckelew.name: Nikki Buckelew
buckelew.style: 'Last-time sellers.' 90% want to age in place. Doing the right thing has its advantages. The first appointment is a needs assessment, not a listing presentation.
buckelew.deep: RESEARCHED (Seniors Real Estate Institute site + her aging-in-place doctrine post; ProAging and Empowering Independence podcasts; LinkedIn /coachnikki). PhD + master's psychology, bachelor's gerontology, 20+ yr REALTOR. Founder/CEO Seniors Real Estate Institute; administrator of the Certified Senior Housing Professional (CSHP) designation; author of the Senior Downsizing Coaching Skills curriculum and Success in Seniors Real Estate. Defining position: the right answer is often NOT to sell - cites ~90% want to age in place, names the commission conflict out loud ('I only get paid if I sell her home'), trains agents to reduce ambivalence and overwhelm and to collaborate WITH adult children. Calm, unhurried, asks more than she tells, removes pressure explicitly.

nemovitz.name: Bruce Nemovitz
nemovitz.style: 'There is no perfect time, but if you're asking the question, the time is near.' No pressure, no rushing, no one-size-fits-all. The job is the transition, not the transaction.
nemovitz.deep: RESEARCHED (brucesteam.com FAQ and Books pages; Moving in the Right Direction via REALTOR Store + Amazon; Guiding Our Parents in the Right Direction; 120+ articles in 50 Plus magazine). 35-40 yr Milwaukee REALTOR, CSA + SRES, NAR sells his book as agent education. Concrete mechanics: list 2-3 months ahead of a senior community move-in date because buyers flex on occupancy; as-is sells at fair market value when priced correctly, so pricing does the work renovation is usually asked to do; clients often 30+ years in the home; sibling conflict resolved with neutral pricing data. Plain, patient, Midwestern, practical over inspirational, dates and sequence attached to every step.

spade.name: Chris Spade
spade.style: Avoid crisis mode. Talk to the adult child like a peer with a hard job. You're not being morbid, you're being useful.
spade.deep: RESEARCHED (Moving Mom and Downsizing Dad podcast, 30+ episodes Jan-Aug 2025, full topic inventory; PR.com launch release). Keller Williams agent, probate and senior relocation specialist. Only voice on the panel aimed at the ADULT CHILD - the Gen X son or daughter who usually books the appointment. Organising idea is 'crisis mode': a family that plans has options on price, timing, condition and tax treatment; a family that waits for the fall or the diagnosis has none. Covers probate avoidance, trusts vs wills, POA, capital gains and the step-up, 1031/DST, reverse mortgages, a 30-day market-ready checklist, senior move managers, estate sales, memory care, caregiver burnout. Works BEFORE death - distinct from Corbett, who works after. Peer to peer, unsentimental, leads with calendar and checklist.

nucci.name: Anthony Nucci
nucci.style: 'I'm not even sure we're a good fit to work together. I just noticed your property should have sold, and I'm curious what happened.' Never open with the weather. Stand up. Volume, consistency, strategy.
nucci.deep: RESEARCHED (his own Medium script post; YouTube @nuccirealestate; TikTok @nuccianthony cold-call breakdowns; Nucci Consulting program pages; Douglas Elliman profile). Douglas Elliman luxury agent, FL + MI, Miami and Detroit, Nucci family portfolio; founder of Nucci Consulting - weekly live roleplay, call rooms, Calls Into Listings event. NOTE: his volume claims vary by source ($100M/6yr personal, $200M+ via cold calling, 1,000+ agents trained, $1B+ collective) - these are marketing claims, cite the method not the scoreboard and never put a dollar figure in a script. Method: never open with small talk because a stranger interrupted mid-day wants to know why you're calling; the takeaway opener that puts the fit in doubt first; redirect an objection into a two-door choice rather than arguing it; energy is mechanical (stand while dialling); script but conversational; tailor questions to FSBO vs expired vs circle. Fast, direct, zero throat-clearing, short sentences.
